xna-type.name: ContentReader
xna-type.summary: A worker object that implements most of ContentManager.Load. A new ContentReader is constructed for each asset loaded.

property.name: AssetName
property.summary: Gets the name of the asset currently being read by this ContentReader.
property.value: Name of the asset currently being read by this ContentReader.
property.remarks: AssetName can be useful to include in the exception message if a custom ContentTypeReader encounters an error.

property.name: ContentManager
property.summary: Gets the ContentManager associated with the ContentReader.
property.value: The ContentManager associated with the ContentReader.

method.name: ReadColor
method.summary: Reads a Color value from the currently open stream.

overload.summary: Reads a Color value from the currently open stream.
overload.returns: The Color value that was read.

method.name: ReadDouble

overload.summary: Reads a double value from the currently open stream.
